messages.subject: using vagrant for shiny development
parts:
Hey everyone!  In the process of getting up and running with Shiny and shiny-server, I put together a project that simplifies things by giving you access to a fully running virtual machine with R, shiny, and the shiny-server all installed and configured.  You can find the project here:

https://github.com/mdagost/vagrant_shiny

It uses vagrant for managing the virtual machines and puppet for doing the provisioning.  The puppet recipe can be easily re-used if you're managing deployments of Shiny apps to various server environments.  There are branches for both Ubuntu and Debian.

Feel free to reach out to me with any comments or issues.  Hope someone else finds this useful.

Michelangelo
